info.name: Kitchen Margin Tracker API
info.description:
All REST endpoints of the Kitchen Margin Tracker backend (Express + MongoDB + Gemini).

**How to run:** import this collection and the `Kitchen Margin Tracker - Local` environment, start the backend (`npm run dev` in backend/),
select the environment and run the whole collection in the Collection Runner. Each run registers a fresh owner (via `runId`),
saves the JWT automatically, adds a manager, checks every role rule and the margin maths, asks the AI assistant, then cleans up.

Every request has tests and a saved example response.

item.description:
AI assistant built on Google Gemini with function calling (needs GEMINI_API_KEY in backend/.env).

POST /ai/chat sends a question, the dashboard filters and the earlier turns of the conversation. Gemini picks from 10 data tools
(KPIs, cost breakdown, margin by dish/platform, discount impact, profit trend, menu costing, fee rules, recent orders, price what-if);
the backend runs them on the outlet's MongoDB data and Gemini answers from the results. The response lists `tools_used` and the `model`.

If a Gemini model is busy the backend falls back to the next model; if all are busy it returns 503. POST /ai/insights always returns
insight cards: written by Gemini when available (`source: "ai"`), otherwise calculated from the same numbers (`source: "computed"`).
